records.name: King Aldric Calderan
records.description: Intelligent, educated, patient, politically cautious, and increasingly frustrated by the limits placed on the Crown.

records.name: Lord Theren Vaelorian
records.description: Cultured, patient, calculating, and difficult to surprise. Prefers financial and diplomatic leverage to direct threats.

records.name: High King Durnak Kharadorn
records.description: Stern, disciplined, traditional, and deeply conscious of his family history.

records.name: Lord Garrick Edarth
records.description: Traditional martial lord who values discipline, loyalty, and reputation.

records.name: Lord Edran Veyr
records.description: Practical and reserved, accustomed to difficult decisions with limited resources.

records.name: Lady Maris Merrowen
records.description: Accomplished political operator with extensive commercial and diplomatic relationships.

records.name: Lord Oswin Denvor
records.description: Measured and observant, preferring negotiated solutions and predictable obligations.

records.name: Lady Catrin Denvor
records.description: Politically capable Denvor household member who maintains civic and charitable relationships.

records.name: Ser Edwyn Denvor
records.description: Recognized heir who favors greater investment in defenses and infrastructure.

records.name: Lady Anwen Denvor
records.description: Perceptive and socially skilled, with genuine relationships outside the nobility.

records.name: Reeve Marrec Holt
records.description: Methodical and protective of administrative records; values dependable civic routines.

records.name: Harbor Master Ysella Vane
records.description: Direct, experienced, and difficult to intimidate. Wants safe traffic and fair quay allocation.

records.name: Chief Magistrate Odran Pell
records.description: Patient, observant, and exacting about testimony.

records.name: Captain Brinna Salk
records.description: Practical and blunt, with strong responsibility toward her patrols.

records.name: Castellan Hadrik Voss
records.description: Veteran professional who values preparation, stores, and clear command.

records.name: Meret Sorn
records.description: Polished and cautious. Values predictable trade, secure cargo, fire prevention, and reliable records.

records.name: Dagna Coppervein
records.description: Exacting craftswoman who protects apprentices, skilled labor, quality standards, and timber supply.

records.name: Pellan Reed
records.description: Sociable, sharp, and politically perceptive. Wants fair river tolls and safe landings.

records.name: Tavren Selwick
records.description: Prosperous merchant known for paying obligations and keeping accurate cargo accounts.

records.name: Nix-of-the-Cistern
records.description: Patient and attentive to practical needs. A local contact, not a representative of all ratfolk.

records.name: Tikka Vell
records.description: Resourceful and commercially ambitious. Wants ratfolk workshops to sell openly in the Market Ward.

records.name: Serren Coil
records.description: Quiet and observant, protective of route knowledge and family shelters.

records.name: Miraq Ashwhisk
records.description: Capable independent craftswoman with a respected surface business.

records.name: Sister Alwen
records.description: Calm, stubborn, and practical. Wants food, shelter, care, burial assistance, and support for abandoned children.

records.name: Brother Caldus
records.description: Thoughtful listener who records names of the missing and lost and values maritime rites.

records.name: Noll Tarrow
records.description: Former tally clerk organizing the loose Grey Net cargo-diversion network in the Old Quays.

records.name: Edrik Vale
records.description: Copyist and occasional contract clerk who produces altered commercial documents and false ownership papers.

records.name: Hessa Quill
records.description: Former household steward who arranges private loans and coercive settlements.

records.name: Sella Vane
records.description: Independent boat owner who moves small quantities of undeclared goods through minor quays and river landings.

records.name: Othric Pell
records.description: Trades schedules, overheard conversations, debt rumors, and introductions. Not omniscient.

records.name: Dannel Rusk
records.description: Independent private debt enforcer who works for multiple creditors and sometimes pushes beyond lawful agreements.

records.name: Prelate Damas Orrel
records.description: Careful administrator of the Open Ledger who emphasizes lawful trade, contracts, civic order, and fair procedure.

records.name: Keeper Lethia Sorn
records.description: Reserved and compassionate priest of the Quiet Gate who insists the dead be treated with dignity.

records.name: Lord Chancellor Othmar Rusk
records.description: Crown administrator and appointed Imperial Council representative with access to royal government and inter-house negotiation.

records.name: Lady Meredyth Sorn
records.description: Precise Crown financial administrator concerned about short-term borrowing and privileges granted to powerful houses.

records.name: Lord Bastian Wycliffe
records.description: Learned jurist cautious about changing law by decree and attentive to royal precedent and noble privilege.

records.name: Marshal Garran Holt
records.description: Career soldier who understands the Crown's military limitations and favors a more reliable royal force.

records.name: Mistress Nerys Vale
records.description: Discreet intelligence officer whose network relies on informants, servants, merchants, messengers, and intermediaries.

records.name: Lord Perrin Ashcombe
records.description: Courtier responsible for royal household operations, ceremony, schedules, palace staff, and access to the monarch.

records.name: Lady Mereth Relland
records.description: Careful and proud head of the minor house, concerned with preserving family standing and its official account of the old South Road incident.

records.name: Ser Corren Relland
records.description: Adult heir focused on restoring House Relland's income and local reputation. His knowledge of the old incident is incomplete.

records.name: Lord Edvar Relland
records.description: Deceased former head of House Relland who controlled the household response to the old South Road incident.

records.name: Ser Deylan Marrick
records.description: Former road-patrol leader who abused his authority while operating under House Relland colors. He died during the South Road incident.
